summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation tools have rapidly matured in 2026, with LLM-native extraction, natural language querying, and autonomous agent capabilities becoming standard features rather than differentiators. The market has bifurcated into developer-focused API-first crawlers (Firecrawl, Apify, AgentQL) and managed browser infrastructure platforms (Browserbase, Bright Data, Playwright), with MCP-native and agentic tooling emerging as the next frontier. Adoption is driven largely by AI/LLM pipeline needs, RAG data preparation, and autonomous agent workflows replacing traditional selector-based scraping.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Open source / free; cloud providers charge separately
ai_features: AI-assisted test generation via Copilot integration
Natural language locators via experimental AI plugins
LLM-powered element selection in community extensions
Integration with AI agent frameworks for autonomous browsing
strengths: Largest developer community and GitHub star count (~70k+)

Extensive ecosystem and plugin library
Self-hosted and cloud-compatible
